text:
Hana Park: Hi all 1 Im Hana, starting today on runtime perf. Laptop delivered (Windows 11) and trying to run CUDA tests under WSL2 but the GPU passthrough isn't visible. Also can't badge into the SF office yet. Quick hello + fun fact: I collect vintage game cartridges. :video_game:

Luca Moretti: welcome Hana! I'm on eng-runtime. For WSL2 you need NVIDIA drivers + WSL experimental features. What does `nvidia-smi` show inside WSL?

Hana Park: inside WSL `nvidia-smi` returns "NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver." Running Windows driver 535.54

Tess Nguyen: hmm that usually means the WSL integration isn't enabled. Steps that worked for me: 1) install the WSL CUDA toolkit from NVIDIA, 2) enable "Virtual Machine Platform" & reboot, 3) `wsl --shutdown` then restart distro. Also make sure Docker Desktop WSL integration is on.

Benji Ortiz: welcome! For quick tests you can run a CPU-only container: `docker run --rm -it --cpus=2 registry.redwood.internal/test/perf:py3-cpu` until GPU is fixed.

Hana Park: tried `wsl --shutdown` and toggled integration, still same error. Also badge reader at the SF lobby shows "Access denied" even after I registered my badge with People Ops.

IT Helpdesk: @Hana Park please confirm your employee ID and the badge number (printed on the back). We'll push a door access reset. Also share output of `wsl -l -v`.

Hana Park: sent badge number via DM. `wsl -l -v` shows:
```
  NAME                   STATE           VERSION
* Ubuntu-22.04           Running         2
```

Luca Moretti: good. Can you run `sudo apt install -y nvidia-cuda-toolkit` inside the distro and then `nvidia-smi`? If that fails, we can try the Windows-side driver rollback; some new drivers broke WSL last week.

Tess Nguyen: also check Docker Desktop > Settings > Resources > WSL Integration > Enable for Ubuntu-22.04 and check the "Use the WSL 2 based engine" box.

Hana Park: installed the toolkit, `nvidia-smi` now errors with "no CUDA-capable device detected". Docker Desktop is integrated.

Benji Ortiz: that suggests driver mismatch. @IT Helpdesk can schedule a remote session to inspect the Windows driver and the WSL GPU feature.

IT Helpdesk: scheduled a remote session at 14:30 PT. We'll attempt a driver reinstall and, if needed, revert to driver 532.09 which is known-good for WSL.

Hana Park: perfect, thanks. Quick onboarding Q: who owns the perf benchmark configs and where are they stored?

Luca Moretti: configs live in `infra/benchmarks/configs` in the monorepo. I'll add you to the repo and share a quick runbook.

Hana Park: thanks! Shirt size: M. Two truths and a lie: I once beat a pro at pinball, Ive never broken a bone, I once coded a pager in college. Guess which is the lie? :pinball:

Tess Nguyen: I'm guessing the pager is real, pinball win is the lie?

Benji Ortiz: I'm putting money on "never broken a bone" being the lie.

Hana Park: plot twist: the lie is that I beat a pro at pinball. :sweat_smile: I did code a pager (hardware) in college and I broke my wrist snowboarding years ago.

People Ops Bot: @Hana Park added to #new-hires and onboarding checklist updated to 1/5. Sticker + hoodie incoming. Welcome! :tada:
